description: This file defines the class 'MonkeyCommandEvent' which extends 'MonkeyEvent' and is used to represent and execute shell command events within the Android 'monkey' testing framework.

classes.name: MonkeyCommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a shell command event in the Android monkey testing framework, capable of executing a shell command and logging its status.

methods.name: MonkeyCommandEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific shell command.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the shell command stored in 'mCmd' and logs the outcome.
